cutadapt_adapter_containing_reads.interpretation: Reads with at least one adapter, separately for each explicitly reported mate.
cutadapt_adapter_containing_reads.missing_behavior: Retain the native token and explicit missing/malformed/partial state. Omitted is not zero; preserve independent valid siblings. Do not reconstruct missing counts from percentages.
native_fields: Reads with adapters / Read 1 or 2 with adapter

times, it overlapped the 3' end or was within the read
